meta.description: Codesidekick Mothership — SvelteKit project management dashboard

AI.usage: Cloudflare AI binding — available as platform.env.AI

KV_INVOICES.usage: Invoice persistence — keys: invoice:{pid}:{id} and invoices:{pid}

projectManifest.pattern: Static manifest array — add projects here only. No DB.

invoices.persistence: Cloudflare KV (KV_INVOICES) with in-memory Map fallback for local dev

ollama.purpose: High-volume low-stakes tasks: summarization, daily briefings, categorization

anthropic.auth: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var (server) or user BYOK via settings store
anthropic.purpose: Reasoning-heavy tasks: chat, project intake AI generation
anthropic.corsProxy: Browser cannot call api.anthropic.com directly — all calls go through server endpoints

aiRouting.strategy: auto | anthropic | ollama — configurable per user via settings.ai.routing
aiRouting.auto: Use Anthropic when available, fall back to Ollama
aiRouting.ollama: Always use Ollama (free, private, lower quality)

routePatterns.serverLoad: +page.server.ts — fetch data server-side (API keys safe here)
routePatterns.dynamicRoute: src/routes/projects/[slug]/ — slug matches project manifest id

integrationArchitecture.pattern: Each integration is a standalone module in src/lib/integrations/
integrationArchitecture.adapterPattern: Integration modules export typed async functions; page.server.ts calls them and passes data to client via SvelteKit load()

typeSystem.platformTypes: src/app.d.ts — KVNamespace, App.Platform with AI + KV_INVOICES bindings

securityNotes: Settings stored in localStorage — personal single-user dashboard only
API keys (Anthropic, Asana, Shopify) are server-side env vars only
BYOK (user Anthropic key) transmitted in POST body — never logged
Browser cannot call api.anthropic.com directly due to CORS; all proxied via /api/anthropic/test
